accepted.label: Hurwicz Criterion
accepted.description: A decision-making criterion that balances optimism and pessimism by computing a weighted average of the best and worst payoffs using a coefficient of optimism (α).
coverage_criteria: Calculate the Hurwicz value for given alternatives and α.
Interpret α as degree of optimism.
Select the alternative with the highest weighted average.
accepted.merge_rationale: Both candidates describe the same subject concept: the Hurwicz criterion as a weighted average of best and worst payoffs with an optimism coefficient. They share implementation-level depth and are testable with identical questions. Merging eliminates duplication.
